# 2 Baruch Chapter 37 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Third Fast and Vision

---

**1** And I prayed and said: O Lord my God, you are able to interpret for me this vision which I have seen.

---

*LOGOS notes: Formal equivalence rendering. A single verse: Baruch's simple prayer requesting the interpretation of the forest-vine vision. The interpretation follows in chs. 39-40.*
